node.title: HGE4 Vandermonde-defect band exclusion
node.statement: For a primitive exact-level pair of width h=m/4-d, put R=log m and x=4(d+1)R/m. Under x<=1, the cubic Taylor norm ceiling is Y_3=4((d+1)R-d)-8(d+1)^2R^2/m+(32/3)(d+1)^3R^3/m^2, while the consecutive even moments force every nonzero defect to occupy at least floor((h-1)/2)+2 coordinates. If Y_3 is at most that rank floor, the pair is antipodal-swap; the proved swap norm then excludes it. At m=2^41 this completely deletes 1<=d<=2,677,220,820. The theorem does not count the remaining lower-quarter pairs or close HGE4.
